title: Learn the venture's equipment and space

steps.do: Read the asset register, the leases, the spend register and the people record, and list what is missing, most needed first: leases and personal guarantees, then devices that hold data, then the rest.

Ask the founder where the venture works (home, coworking, an office) and, for every lease or membership, its term, rent, notice days, auto-renewal and any personal guarantee, and abstract each into a lease record.
Ask which devices and equipment the venture owns, leases or uses, who holds each, and what it cost; register every item above the capitalization threshold and every device that holds data.
Ask whether any founder's own equipment was given to the venture, record it as contributed, and bring the ownership question to the founder.
Tell the founder what the register and leases now hold: the item count and total cost, who holds which data device, and every lease date in the next 12 months, each citing its record.

done_criteria.check: Does every active lease record its end date (or month-to-month), its notice days and whether a founder guarantees it?
